opening.argument: The material directs viewers to “join forsage BUSD platform” and displays a WhatsApp link alongside “Start your online business with me,” Forsage and Team Warriors branding, and an “80k sy 1 lakh” earnings claim. The spoken message ties participation to an investment of 20,000 to 25,000 rupees, addresses schoolfellows as prospective participants, and presents the prospect of earning 80,000 rupees in one month: “today they earn Rs. 80,000, one month.” It also describes obtaining a position “through them today we get this position,” linking advancement to other people. Taken together, these are recruitment-oriented investment claims and a direct invitation to start the business through the promoted channel.
